title: Stored neural soma carried one jump from Node Beta to the Node Alpha soma bid
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-16 13:15 UTC (orders.log ENT-014, block APOLLO (1): sell the stored soma as the pools refill). Node Alpha's soma bid stood at 731 x 2 at 12:07 UTC and read 0 at 12:15 UTC (ledger.py prices voidborn_neural_soma); haulers store soma by ones to fours at Synchrony Hub (30) and Node Beta (16) (data/stock/storage.json, 12:21 to 12:26 UTC). A pilot whose own storage at Node Beta holds soma withdraws 2 there (the circuit runner's withdraw step), sells into the Node Alpha bid at 500 cr or more and stores what the bid did not take there. requires.bid closes it while a book read within the hour shows that bid gone or under 500 cr. Nothing is bought; a run into a bid that left costs two jumps of fuel. A test: one ship until its first RESULT line.
